Request To Set Matter For Prove Up Hearing
Off Calendar Jan-19-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Judge: Donald J. Sullivan, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, Reporter: Sonia Wong, CSR #11288.

Stephen B. McDonagh, Esq. appeared with plaintiff Louis F. Reyes, who was placed under oath and examined.
No appearance by defendants Craig Pearce or HOL'N JAM Enterprises, Inc.
Default was entered against defendant HOL'N JAM Enterprises, Inc. on March 22, 2011.
Default was entered against defendant Craig Pearce on August 24, 2011.
Doe defendants were dismissed on August 24, 2011.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff Louis F. Reyes, and against defendants Craig Pearce, an individual, and HOL'N Jam Enterprises, Inc., a California corporation, as follows:

Principal - $37,000.00.
Prejudgment Interest - $10,048.74.
Attorney Fees - $0.00.
Costs - $578.00.

Total - $47,626.74.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
